name: clankit-dev
description: The design-to-build workflow — a session bootstrap that triages an ask before any ceremony and routes an approved design to the right destination; plus autopilot (small features end-to-end in a worktree), my-prs (open-PR status overview and what to tackle first), screenshot (Playwright-driven page capture), visualize-code (interactive structure diagrams), writing-clearly-and-concisely (Strunk prose rules), and a context-budget hook that reports context usage each turn
